responsibility_name: Ensure a full garbage bin is emptied promptly

evidence.evidence_text: If the bin is full and the window is closed, turn on the air freshener and send me the "It is urgent to throw out the garbage" notification

coding.rationale: Bin-full detection triggers urgent disposal prompt; failure leaves full bin causing odor and overflow inconvenience.

responsibility_name: Ensure toilet paper is restocked before it runs out

evidence.evidence_text: When I go to the bathroom in the bathroom and then lower the toilet seat, if the toilet paper is finished I am warned by an acoustic signal.

coding.rationale: Warning fires when toilet paper runs out; failure is a consumable shortage during bathroom use.

evidence.evidence_text: If it's Sunday and Rumba hasn't been fired, activate it

coding.rationale: Sunday deadline check triggers vacuum if not yet run; failure means scheduled weekly cleaning missed.

When the motion sensors detect you move from the kitchen to another room, Roomba turns on and cleans the floor

responsibility_name: keep garbage container sanitized and bagged

evidence.evidence_text: When the garbage container does not detect the bag, then activate the sanitizer and insert the new bag

coding.rationale: Missing-bag detection triggers sanitize and re-bag; failure leaves container unhygienic and unusable.

responsibility_name: Keep kitchen air safe and clean while cooking

evidence.evidence_text: If the induction hob is active and if there is smoke, activate the extractor hood and turn on the automatic perfumer.

coding.rationale: Smoke during cooking triggers extraction; failure exposes occupants to smoke and poor air quality.

coding.rationale: Holiday 9:00 vacancy check triggers floor cleaning; code targets the cleaning subtask of the source rule.

coding.rationale: Bacteria threshold triggers cleaning; failure risks hygiene-related harm to occupants.
